name: Sentier du Nord
description_md:
The Sentier du Nord is a waymarked hiking route in LU spanning 69.6 km. The route requires about 24 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule and has a hard difficulty derived from distance and ascent.

This national waymarked hiking network trail is signposted as SDN. The route includes 2263 m of ascent and 2561 m of descent. Walkers will find that the route passes Diekirch within 200 m and Clervaux within 400 m.
